faqSection.title: Find your answers
faqSection.description: Quick answers about our solutions and how we help your team.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to implement AI in my company?
items.answer: No. We handle the full development and integration. Your team only needs to use the final solution, which we design to be as simple as possible.

items.question: Do you provide on-site consulting at the company?
items.answer: Yes. We visit client facilities to analyze internal processes in person and identify bottlenecks and automation opportunities that are hard to spot remotely.

items.question: Can you build an online store for my retail business or restaurant?
items.answer: Yes. We implement online ordering systems and websites for shops and restaurants with a very simple control panel for non-technical teams.

items.question: Do your solutions work with any ERP or system?
items.answer: Yes. We work with SAP, Dynamics AX, Holded, Sage and any system with an API or database access.

items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: An online store for a local business in 1-2 weeks. A simple automation in about 2 weeks. A full AI agent with ERP integration in 4 to 8 weeks.

items.question: Do you issue VAT invoices?
items.answer: Yes. We are registered freelancers in Spain and fully tax compliant. We issue VAT invoices and operate with companies across Europe with intra-community VAT numbers.

faq.title: What people ask us before starting
faq.description: If you have another question, call or write to us and we'll answer it.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: It depends on the type of site and what it includes. After a first call we give you a fixed quote with no hidden costs. For a reference, our blog has a guide to market prices in 2026.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: It depends on the project: a simple business site takes much less than an online shop. Before starting, we give you a specific timeline in the proposal.

items.question: Does the website include SEO?
items.answer: Yes. All our sites launch with on-page SEO: structure, titles, descriptions, speed, structured data, sitemap and Google Search Console setup. Ongoing SEO (content and campaigns) can be contracted separately.

items.question: Will I be able to update the website myself?
items.answer: If you need to, we leave the site ready for you to change text, photos or publish on the blog, and we show you how.

items.question: Do you help with domain, hosting and email?
items.answer: Yes. We advise you on choosing a domain and hosting and set everything up so you don't have to worry about the technical side.

items.question: Do you only work in Gipuzkoa?
items.answer: We're based in Elgoibar and work with businesses across Gipuzkoa and the Basque Country, but we also build websites for clients anywhere in Spain: almost the whole process can be done remotely.
